outcomes.text: Explain what a presentation tests and read its brief.
Build a presentation to a brief by working through a structured method.
Rehearse aloud to time and fix parts of a talk that overrun or stumble.
Design accessible slides with little text and clear contrast.
Name own strengths and weak points as a presenter after rehearsal.

journey.practice: At this tier the learner reads a presentation brief, works through a set method with support, and starts rehearsing aloud to catch and fix what overruns or stumbles.
journey.knowledge: What a presentation assesses, the steps of one set method for building it, and where in a rehearsed run-through their own talk is weak.
journey.identity: A newcomer who sees presenting as a practice worth learning, beginning to check their own performance against the method rather than only following it.
